statement: ∀ (R H U E P : ℕ → ℝ) (a b ε : ℝ), 0<ε → a+b+ε<1 → (∀ x, R x ≤ H x + U x + E x + P x) → (∀ x, H x ≤ a*R x) → (∀ x, E x ≤ ε*R x) → ∀ x, U x ≤ b*R x → (1-a-b-ε)*R x ≤ P x

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Combine two disjoint sieve losses

brief.zh: 令 $U_x$ 计 $f(k)=pq,\ 2z_1<p<q,\ q-p>H$ 的参数。若有固定 $a,b\ge0,\ a+b<1$，最终 $H_x(2z_0,z_1]\le aR_x(z_0)$，且无界的 $x$ 满足 $U_x\le bR_x(z_0)$，则 S01、S03、S06 给真素数参数数目 $\ge(1-a-b)c_0 x/(2\log x)$ 沿同一列成立。先按第一素因子切去两端，再切近等因子带，将近等因子带限于 $p>2z_1$ 以保持互斥。乘以窗内的 $\log f(k)$，接 `levent-prime-values-recurrent-mass`。
brief.en: Use the same scale and reserve a strictly positive margin after both losses and the edge cost.
